preconditions: USB/J2 disconnected;upper/belt out;ties/tape released;flexible branches unplugged and parked outside sweeps;wire guide removed before bridge inward travel;optical/support group removed before carrier;side sockets unplugged after carrier removal.

precision.note: Flat faces are exact; curved faces are within 0.02 mm of the true surface, so a distance up to 0.02 mm counts as contact. Depth is sampled at about 0.2 mm spacing.
precision.sampling: No point of the moving objects travels more than 0.5 mm between two poses. A contact shorter than that along the path can fall between poses, and a smallest clearance is within that much of the smallest over the poses. Inside a run of overlapping poses one pose in up to 7 is measured and the run counts as overlapping throughout; the swept overlap is the union of up to 32 of the overlapping poses, spread evenly along them.
